Sprint01ForwardWalk.title: Forward walks: 3,145 four-digit prefixes the width-8 forward invariant from time 100 cannot exclude
Sprint01ForwardWalk.scope: Obstruction for the Agent124.Forward method, not a statement about palindromes of 196. For each of the 3,145 four-digit prefixes in `obstructed8` (3,134 with noOverflowPre plus 11 lead-one prefixes), an explicit list of inner carries walks the width-8 projection of orbit 196 100 to a full-width digit word beginning with that prefix (`forward_obstruction8`), so every code set that is closed under both forwardPrefix carry choices (fwdOK at width 8) and contains that projection contains an element of initialWordsL 8 pre. Generic lemma `forward_cannot_exclude`. Not claimed: anything at other widths or start times, anything about whether such palindromes occur, or about the backward (rank-certificate) method.
